entities.summary: Prince Constantin Jean Lars Anthony Démétrius Karadja was a Greek-Romanian diplomat, barrister-at-law, bibliographer, bibliophile and honorary member (1946) of the Romanian Academy. He was a member of the Caradja aristocratic family.
